name: NDVI Anomaly Detection
description: Computes the per-pixel NDVI anomaly from Sentinel-2 L2A imagery by comparing the current month's mean NDVI against the same-month average over the previous N years. Negative values indicate vegetation loss (e.g. drought or crop loss), positive values indicate vegetation gain. Adapted from a SentinelHub Custom Script by Jean-Baptiste Pleynet.
